# A restored closed-object assertion still needs a useful failure message

Review requested retaining the closed-object assertion as an early debugging signal, and the landed source keeps it before the early return. Its message remains a dated marker. A concrete expected-state message would explain that the MIME object should remain open before parsing. This is a scoped diagnostic suggestion under the current assertion-message guidance, not a reason to remove the assertion or rewrite unrelated legacy diagnostics.

Scope: MIME decoder diagnostics.
